before.requirement: Decode magicless frames through a configured DStream.
before.reason: The before interface is described as compression only, its stream parser requires an ordinary magic number, and its DStream parameter setter supports only maximum window size. Magicless decoding was not a supported format on this side.

source_evidence.quote:
/*===   New advanced API (experimental, and compression only)  ===*/
 *   In this proposal, parameters are pushed one by one into an existing CCtx,
 *   It stands a good chance to become "stable",
 *   after a reasonable testing period.
 *   It feels clearer in light of potential variants :
 *   ZSTD_DCtx_setParameter()  (rather than ZSTD_setDCtxParameter() )
 *   Left variant feels easier to distinguish.
 * All enum will be manually set to explicit values before reaching "stable API" status */

after.requirement: Set ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless on the DStream before decoding a magicless frame.
after.reason: The new format requires an instruction, and the new setter can apply it before decoding. The fixed harness initializes or resets the stream, then calls decompressStream without setting the format; the ordinary format causes magicless input to fail the header check.

source_evidence.quote:
/*! ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat() :
 *  Instruct the decoder context about what kind of data to decode next.
 *  This instruction is mandatory to decode data without a fully-formed header,
 *  such ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless for example.
 * @return : 0, or an error code (which can be tested using ZSTD_isError()).
 */
ZSTDLIB_API size_t ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat(ZSTD_DCtx* dctx, ZSTD_format_e format);

claims.reason: The missing format-setting call blocks c1 after the change. Before the change, the magicless decoding requirement did not exist, so there is no same before-side blocker.
